noteA: OpenID Connect Claims Aggregation. A Claims Provider is another OpenID Provider that vouches for claims about a person this realm does not hold. A person links one on the portal; after that a relying party asking for one of its claims gets it as an aggregated claim (the provider's signed JWT, verified here first) or a distributed one (its endpoint and the person's access token there) — never in place of a value the person's own entry holds.
